scientific_integrity: A detailed proof supplies a complete finite-size first-regular-power distribution (including bounded-chain-forest subtraction), conditional chain tails, rank concentration, and a negligible-cycle-free bound. Independent small-case enumeration and numerical tail checks corroborate but do not replace the proof. No external audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: The limit concerns labeled injective partial graph endomorphisms of growing stars, sampled uniformly, and repeated powers of a single element; it does not address noninjective maps or independent products. Earlier exact regularity and partial-injection enumeration are credited to the cited papers. Publication-priority verification is incomplete.
title: Exponential regularization time for random injective star endomorphisms
